Looking into buying my first new car, and I have narrowed it down to these two. I haven't be able to schedule a test drive with these two cars yet because if their limited availability, but I wanted to know the options of the community on them.

The pros and cons I've worked out so far are.

Miata: Pros: Faster,better mpg, rwd,convertible. Cons: low storage space, can't have a roof rack so will have to get a trailer ,two seater, low crash test scores

ST: Pros: better road holding, more storge/seating, roof rack for my kayaks, reported to be more fun. lower insurance rate Cons: slow, poor mpg, not as sporty stance.

edit: Just for clarification, the Fiesta ST is the 200hp track ready version of the normal Fiesta.

If its your only car, the Fiesta is much more practical, especially since you mentioned kayaks. Much easier to hit the river(or lake) when you don't also need a trailer to haul your toys. The ST version of the Fiesta will inject fun in a very practical car- while also getting rid of a horrible transmission prone to breaking. I've driven a base fiesta(with manual, 2013 version) from LA to Phoenix, and have also driven a 2009-ish Miata from San Diego to LA, and actually enjoyed the Fiesta more, part of the cause of which was LA traffic(stick in traffic is not as fun), part because the Miata's a/c was anemic(105F that day and convertibles don't help in stand-still traffic)

Fiesta ST hands down, I'm planning on getting one, I've driven the wrx, but perfer the Fiesta. If you're into performance mods, it's only about 2k to jump up to stage 2 and the stock power to weight ratio is real nice, it's the same as the 1st gen BMW M3

Fiesta! I was shopping for cars the last few months, and it was one of my choices. Small, useful, and nice looking for being a sub compact. Also, like most cars, if you ever feel like modifying it in the future it should be relatively easy. The miata is great looking, but seems impractical for an only car.

In the end of my car search I went with a 2016 Civic due to the features it had standard compared to other cars. However, due to it being a new model there are shit for accessories for a few more months.
